<p align="center">Show Cue Plotter. Plan our lighting effects, pyro, sound, all in one tool. Free and Open Source.</p>

## Goals

- Be usable in the real world
- Be quick enough to start working in a live environment and continue working over long periods
- Work reliably

## Non-goals

- This won't be a 1:1 copy of [CuePoints](https://cuepoints.com/). CuePoints will have more features, I just wanted something a bit easier to plot lighting than a word document!

# Prerequisites

This project uses [VLC Media Player](https://www.videolan.org/vlc/index.html) for audio / video playback. Download it and done

# Installation

No binaries are out yet, come back later or follow build instructions below!

## Build Instructions

We use [UV](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) for this project.
Get it, clone the repo and run `uv run src/main.py` and done!
